subject: Vendor portal evidence prioritization matrix & phased upload plan
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@brightleaf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-ops@brightleaf.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask — BrightLeaf portal access + what to upload first

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Per our compliance desk, we need to get Redwood's OneTrust/Whistic/Vendr profiles in a state that maps to our SOC 2 / CAIQ baseline. We can provision a vendor admin account but the security team asked for guidance on what to prioritize for the first pass — we have limited bandwidth over the next two weeks.

Quick context: BrightLeaf is running an internal evidence intake window next week and would like to ingest anything Redwood can stage via API or CSV. Our security ops asked for:
- A short list of the "must-have" artifacts (SOC 2 report, network diagram, KMS policy, encryption-at-rest config)
- A mapping to CAIQ questions if you have one (helpful but optional)
- Any small sample CSV to validate our ingestion job

Can you send a short prioritized matrix and a phased upload plan? We can provide portal admin access to Vendr and a Whistic upload token by EOD if that helps.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Kim
Security Program Manager, BrightLeaf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — BrightLeaf portal access + what to upload first

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and for offering tokens/access. Below is the prioritization matrix we propose (short, actionable) plus a 3-wave upload plan we can commit to that aligns with your ingestion window.

Priority matrix (minimal "first pass" items):
- Priority A (upload within 48 hours): SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed), public encryption-at-rest statement, contact for breach notification, KMS provider name and rotation cadence.
- Priority B (next 3–7 days): Network diagram (high level), third-party subprocessors list, IAM policy summary (roles and MFA enforcement), logging/monitoring retention.
- Priority C (next 7–14 days): CAIQ mappings for key controls, sample config snippets (S3 bucket policies), incident response runbook (summary), penetration test summary.

Phased upload plan (we'll coordinate with your portal):
- Wave 1 (48 hrs): Push Priority A docs to a protected Vendr intake folder and create a small CSV (s3_evidence_index.csv) with metadata fields your ingestion job needs (filename, control tags, date, access URL).
- Wave 2 (days 3–7): Add Priority B artifacts to Whistic / OneTrust profile fields and attach network diagram PDF.
- Wave 3 (days 7–14): Add CAIQ-question crosswalk and add supplemental artifacts requested by your reviewers.

Operational notes / ask from BrightLeaf: please provide a Vendr ticket or upload token (you mentioned you can) and a sample ingestion schema (CSV column list). We'll include a sample CSV and a screenshot of the portal permissions once we provision the upload.

I've attached the s3_evidence_index.csv sample and a quick permissions screenshot so your ops team can confirm expected fields. Neha — tagging you here to confirm NDAs/any gating before we publish SOC 2 to a third-party portal. Marcus / Ben — can you own the Wave 2 Whistic uploads if we get the token?

Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — BrightLeaf portal access + what to upload first

Marissa / team — quick gating notes from Security:
- SOC 2 report: redact customer-specific attachments and ensure the report stored in Vendr has an access expiration (we recommend 30 days for external uploads).
- For any KMS/key material references, do not include key values or Arn-level credentials; summary statements and rotation cadence are fine.
- CAIQ mapping: we'll provide a short crosswalk template — Marcus, can you pull the canonical mapping we used for Acme? Put it in the Drive folder Marissa linked.

I'll approve Wave 1 once the sample CSV is validated and I confirm redaction on the SOC 2. If BrightLeaf needs a longer access window we can make a case, but ask them to sign a temporary access addendum (I can draft).

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security Operations

From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@brightleaf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-ops@brightleaf.com
Date: 2028-06-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — BrightLeaf portal access + what to upload first

Marissa / Neha — thanks, this is perfect. We will:
- Create a Vendr ticket BL-4729 and provision a one-time upload token for Wave 1 by tomorrow 9am PT.
- Ingest the sample CSV you attached (s3_evidence_index.csv) and confirm field mappings.
- Grant a temporary read window of 45 days (we can extend on request) — I will attach the token and a link to the intake endpoint in the Vendr ticket.

Next steps:
- Marissa: upload Wave 1 to the Vendr intake folder and paste the ticket link into the CSV's metadata field.
- Neha: draft the short temporary access addendum and share in the Drive folder.
- Marcus / Ben: coordinate Whistic uploads for Wave 2 once link/token is live.

We will include a screenshot of the ingestion mapping and any errors we see. Appreciate the staged approach — should make the review much faster.

Regards,
Alice Kim
Security Program Manager, BrightLeaf
